segments.name: Progressive Leasing
segments.description: Offers in-store, app-based and e-commerce lease-to-own solutions, buying merchandise from retail POS partners and leasing it to consumers who may lack traditional credit.
segments.evidence: Progressive Leasing provides in-store, app-based, and e-commerce point-of-sale lease-to-own solutions through approximately 24,000 third-party POS partner locations and e-commerce websites in 45 states, the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico.

segments.name: Four
segments.description: Offers buy now, pay later installment plans through its mobile app, letting consumers split purchases into interest-free payments at retailers.
segments.evidence: Four enables consumers of various credit backgrounds to pay for purchases over time through short-term, interest-free installment BNPL plans.

revenueModel.text: Consumers pay lease and installment amounts to PROG Holdings, which buys merchandise from retail partners and finances customer purchases.
revenueModel.evidence: It does so by purchasing merchandise from the POS partners desired by customers and, in turn, leasing that merchandise to the customers through a cancellable lease-to-own transaction.

changes.text: PROG Holdings sold substantially all of Vive's loan receivables in 2025 and now reports Vive as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: Vive is presented as discontinued operations in the Company's consolidated financial statements.

changes.text: Four became a reportable segment in 2025 as its financial results became significant.
changes.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, Four is a reportable segment, as its financial results are considered significant to the Company's consolidated financial results.
